notes.title: FART to the top, WIN a pig!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey friends![/b][/h2]

This time we will focus mainly on [b]Tales From The Arcade: Fartmania[/b], because there is a lot to talk about! In addition, until the end of May [b]you have a chance to take part in a contest where there is a cool prize to win![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/88b7fdd596856efc2c76bfebe49df7e2e54542a2.png[/img]

[b][h1]FARTMANIA IS OUT![/h1][/b](on Newgrounds)

Let's start with the fact that Fartmania is finally out. [b]From now you can play our latest production on [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/928823]Newgrounds[/url]![/b] We are very pleased with how TFTA Fartmania looks in the final version, another dream on our list ticked off. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/691b5c3d8b1c6716843158d8d706d17e276f7e22.gif[/img]

For those who do not yet know what our new game is about, we're here to tell you - [b]Fartmania is a new installment in the Tales From The Arcade series.[/b] This time we decided to make an arcade platformer starring pigs. Our character Pinky has a farting problem and is being ridiculed by others in the village. However, when the other piglets are kidnapped by aliens, Pinky the Stinky must use his unusual powers and rescue his pals from the hands of the alien visitors. [b]Will this mission succeed and will Pinky gain the respect of the village? It's all up to you.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/be2bae62810e0e4e505faad69c5a5d07ff7fa877.gif[/img]

[b][h1]FART-ASTIC CONTEST![/h1][/b](Seriously, it's really cool!)

[b]But you are probably also interested in the contest we’ve mentioned at the beginning.[/b] Well, we want to see how well you do in our new arcade platformer. Therefore, show us what the highest score you are able to fart out in Fartmania!

- Go to [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/928823]Newgrounds[/url] and play TFTA: Fartmania
- Launch the Fart-o-meter and start the adventure.
- Reach the top of the sky and defeat the aliens, completing the game in the shortest possible time and saving as many pigs as you can.

[b]Every second counts, just as every little piglet is extra points to your score! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/fe259442b22bcdf2afe7507d465d620a49a5f744.gif[/img]

Okay, but what's all the fuss about? [b][h3]The person who at the end of the contest will appear in the first place of highscores on Newgrounds will become.... a character in TFTA: Fartmania![/h3][/b] We will prepare for you a personalized piggy character that will appear in the game. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that may not be repeated. [b]There is a lot to fight for, so drop on Newgrounds, break records and fart your way to the top![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551684/2916ff7b02cfb7a70e6ec089ecf595be95e20635.gif[/img]
[i](Become a character in Fartmania, just like our patreons Kaja and Adam!)[/i]

The contest runs until May 31, 2024.

[b]So what are you waiting for? Stop reading and start farting! [/b]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Give old sports facilities a second life! Sports: Renovations announced
notes.content:
What happens when a sports game meets a house renovator? A game where you renovate old sports facilities! 

Restore the glory of sports in a [b]relaxing renovator sim[/b], made by Goat Gamez, a studio founded by Movie Games and [b]Robert Lewandowski[/b]!

Wishlist the game now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230960/Sports_Renovations/

How do you save your beloved team’s court from being torn down by a real estate developer? You do what you do best – renovate dilapidated sports facilities to collect the money you need to help out.

Restore gyms, courts, pools and pitches to their former glory, upgrade your tools and expand your headquarters. Collect trophies and mementoes during your renovation missions and display them proudly in a special room for everyone to see.

[b]FEATURES:[/b]

[list][*]Two game modes: Campaign with a predefined number of levels and storyline.
[*]Buy new tools and upgrade the equipment you already own.
[*]Earn money on your renovation jobs and use it to expand your own base of operations – each room unlocked will add some perks and some of the rooms come with a side mission.
[*]Buy cosmetic items you can place around your office.
[*]Trophy room where the player sees various memorabilia collected during renovation missions.[/list]

Are you ready to give sports facilities a second chance?

notes.title: Full Dead Horizon adventure game demo now playable!
notes.content:
Hey Everybody!

Kuba from My Next Games here. For few years now I've been helping my friend Matthew to bring to life his vision for a game. We finaly have somthing we would like to share with you. I'm not that good with words so let me just pass it on to Matt:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1368540/Dead_Horizon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26308370/a2a10103690f4e083dbd3d33cc63e3cfe3ab7336.png[/img][/url]

Greetings fellow shootists!

Over the years a lot of people have told me that if there was a more fleshed out version of a game I made. It was a short adventure game that is about ten minutes long. People liked it but they wanted something with you know... more... game in it.

I have been working on a more fleshed out version of that other game for a few years. Now I have a demo to show off!

The demo was supposed to be shown off in the steamfest this week, but...

Well, I am also sometimes an idiot. I messed up the submission process twice so instead... the demo is going to be available next week! I'll have my OWN Steamfest! It won't have blackjack or hookers but it will have the (Still slightly janky) demo for Dead Horizon: The Longer Version!

This game will be a full adventure game with point and click stuff going on. An inventory. It includes...
[list]
[*] The ability to talk to people.
[*] The ability to shoot people.
[*] An inventory.
[*] A lot of niche and optional content most people will never see because sometimes late at night I can't sleep and I just go write long conversations
[*] The ability to look at things and get descriptions of them!
[*] No voice acting!
[*] Being slightly unfinished. SFX especially need a touch more work.
[*] An obvious representation of my psyche an world view in video game form.
[*] A weird sci0fi western setting that seems to be a normal western setting at first but if you read way too many of the buried look ats you realize 'wait what?!' and then you are like 'oh, okay' and then you're like 'huh, maybe he should have made this more obvious?'
[*] Years of blood and sweat soaked into the code and pixels in a desperate attempt to hold onto my nostalgia of the 90s.
[*] Ability to shoot someone's hat off their head.
[*] Pixel art that is really really keeno!
[*] Play as a drunk!
[*] Freak people out by pulling your gun out randomly mid conversation.
[*] Um... there's other stuff. I think.
[/list]

It's something you can check out right now. You can play it over here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1368540/Dead_Horizon/

The demo will be up and playable for a week or so. Feel free to play it, wishlist it, tell people about it, make fun of it, hate it, or whatever. I mean, I can't control you. You seem like an independent and smart minded person if you've reading this update, and you know what? I trust you.

You'll probably get what I'm trying to build here.

Feel free to tell me if I am missing the mark! This is a demo meaning that feedback at this stage is fantabulous.

I hope all of you find what you are looking for out in the shifting sands.

-Always

Matthew Ritter

notes.title: Taint Room Progression
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/8f8e8b33b7ba482ae7498110d36c1cea4ab976ac.gif[/img]
Hey Everybody - Happy Easters!
Yup! The new Soulblight update is now live. When you launch the game you might noticed the following things:
[list]
    [*]Taints are now randomly assigned to the path  
    [*]Not all taint room paths are unlocked from the start
[/list]
What we've realized during last couple of weeks was that allowing player to chose from all 4 taints every level actually decreased the replay value of our game. After few runs everybody has a favorite setup and stops experimenting with other available option. Yes - randomly assigning taints to the path and adding a lot of new taints would have solved the problem. Although we plan on adding new personalities it will take some time and we thought this problem couldn't wait that long. On the other hand some of you mentioned the game could use some additional progression mechanics. And so the idea pop into our minds - we've decided to kill two birds with a one stone :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/6be57dfd77cbff68e91b4f7e4fbb89246aafbc41.gif[/img]

Now at the start of the game only two paths with random taints will be available. This way you will no longer be able to use the same taint setup in every game. To get access to additional choice options you will need to unlock the other paths. You do it with Corrupted Cores. Every time you defeat the boss you will get one Corrupted Core. Power up the taint room with 3 of thous and a new path will open :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/aeed26a38bd23d2b8f55e335d901cd160ce53aa3.gif[/img]

To add even more depth to taint selection we've also introduced to the game a less powerful version of the core. The Energy Core will alow you to re-role one of the taint options and it is now available to buy at Cecil's Dungeon Crawling Paraphernalia Emporium ;)

Cya Around,
Kuba

P.S
The Dev vlog for this week:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1349584979

If you guys have any ideas on what you'd like to see added to the game feel free to post them on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/530930]community hub[/url] or https://www.reddit.com/r/MyNextGames Subreedit

notes.title: Kickstarter Update 5#: Character’s Conditions
notes.content:
As you can see today we have another extensive topic :) Let’s just jump straight into it :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/8ed984c2ae1b044bc5a854985ec72951e237b86a.png[/img] 

One of the early design challenges during the development of Soulblight was creating a context for all the action the player would have to take in order express his characters. To solve that we’ve decided to add a survival aspect to our game. We’ve done it by allowing the character to be a subject of various conditions. To avoid confusion and allow the player to easily compare buffs he receives we’ve created a special state called synergy. What it does is it represents the character’s overall well being (both physical and psychic) and greatly increases damage and resistance. To systemize the mechanics even further we’ve also divided the conditions into 4 categories:

[list]
[*][b]Positive Conditions[/b] - Simple buffs meant to make you stronger by temporarily increasing the synergy. Example: Rage
[*][b]Negative Conditions[/b] -Simple debuffs that won’t kill you but make you weaker by decreasing your synergy. Example: Hunger
[*][b]Injuries[/b] - Serious wounds. With every one of these you get closer and closer to death. You can sustain up to 4 Injuries at the same time. Example: Bleeding wound
[*][b]Taints[/b] - The personality traits you acquire during your journey besides giving you a passive synergy buff also unlock a new mechanics. Example: Greed 
[/list]

Now the fun part starts when the different conditions start to intertwine. Let’s look at hunger example:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/ecb5eccbd53ba08d71ebb1697d6f2a92a9061106.png[/img]

The hunger builds up with the time you play. It starts as a small harmless debuf but can build up to enormous proportion. That’s why It is important to eat regularly especially when you have a concussion injury (it will speed up the healing process). Saving candies for later might be a good idea but their nutritional value isn’t too high. This means that a piece of candy will nullify the hunger just for a short time. It is good thing to have one of these when hunger pins you down before the boss fight. When you run out of food and you’re very hungry you might also consider eating some bad berries. They will give you a food poisoning but sometimes it is better to suffer through it then allow for the hunger to build up even more. If you bump into this dilemma often it might be worth going with Glutton taint. One of it’s secondary mechanics is food poisoning immunity.

As you can see each mechanics condition is pretty simple. Put them tougher though and a deep gameplay full of interesting choices emerges :)

Cya Around,
Kuba

P.S Don't forget to visit our kickstarter page: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1752350052/soulblight

notes.title: Kickstarter Update 2#: The Nuances Of Sneaking
notes.content:
After an update on combat it’s time for the one about sneaking. We design stealth in Soulblight to be complementary to fighting. This means that when properly used in combination with fighting it will give you a huge advantage.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/7eea59366e14c79acb9faad1960e0c6962f6ba54.gif[/img]
Let’s start with how exactly Stealth mode works. By holding a button you enter the sneaking mode. What it does is it lowers your speed of movement making your steps silent and at the same time it enables you to see the enemies cones of vision. Now all you need to do is get behind your enemy and snap its neck.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/2fe375bfeaa6ab64364bae3be600b90bf9a2d364.gif[/img]
The challenge starts when you bump into squeaking terrain like old wooden footbridge - here every step will make a noise. To mitigate that you will have to move even slower with gentle use of the analog stick.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/3a1444ada1cd2bec4492b5b0b2716b014b47c74c.gif[/img]
To upgrade your sneaking capabilities you can use special equipment that increases your speed or allows you to ignore the loud terrain. There are also the Chrono Inhibitors capable of bending the time itself slowing it down for a moment when you most need it.

That would be all for today - hope you like it. If you have any questions feel free to ask them in the comments section and don't forget to visit our kickstarter page: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1752350052/soulblight

Cya Around,
Kuba

notes.title: Soulblight Kickstarter - OCT 17th
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/9ca90e1a54de7573fe19a711e449c5369a2d6733.png[/img]

Hey Everybody!
As you know last month we’ve decided to delay our Kickstarter campaign in order to spend more time polishing it. Since then we’ve been working very hard and this time I’ve decided not to mention anything about it until we were 100% satisfied with our pitch. And now, since we are, the time has come to finally announce it - [b]Soulblight Kickstarter campaign will go live on October 17th[/b] ( btw it just so happens that it’s just one day after my birthday ;) )

Now let's talk a bit about some of the improvements we’ve made to the campaign:

[h1]Demo[/h1]
First of all to reward you for waiting we've decided to add a demo access as an additional Kickstarter reward! :) We will send out the demo keys just after the end of the campaign! So if you decide to become our backer you will be able to try out Soulblight really soon!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/d16bd87eb8e16bbd309bfaa36035b5223c91e8e1.png[/img]

[h1]New Main Message[/h1]
One of the main reasons for postponing Kickstarter was the fact that our “More literal approach to RPG” pitch was a bit too abstract to get across without at least two paragraphs of text. However removing this aspect from the game to make it more “promotable” was absolutely out of the question. The only solution was finding a new way of talking about our game. The answer came to us at PAX West. While chatting with all the people visiting our stand we’ve realized that we’ve been focusing on a wrong thing in our pitch. Instead of talking about game’s mechanics we should be emphasizing what we’re actually trying to say with it.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/16cf450b094c60d9f06282e6b424acded5ed2f34.png[/img]

Probably some of you already know what I’m talking about :). The question: [i]“Why the personalities you can acquire in the game are always negative?”[/i] was popping out quite regularly. It was natural as all the little signs were already there:
[list]
[*]The name of the game - “Soulblight” suggest that it’s about the sickness of the soul
[*]The quote form “The Divine Comedy” in the trailer pointed in this direction as well
[*]Our main art presenting that the greatest danger in the game will come “from behind you”
[*]The fact that we chose to call progression system in the game “Taining Mechanic” was also a hint
[/list]
All this was already there. What was lacking were three sentences with which we could explain all that to the person that knows absolutely nothing about the game. (btw never thought writing 3 sentences can be that hard) And so here it is:

[b][i]Soulblight is a dark, top-down roguelike luring you to cross the thin line between good and evil. Embrace your flaws to survive a journey through an unforgiving Sanctuary. Gluttony, Lust, Cannibalism - how far are you willing to go?[/i][/b]

[h1]New Main Art[/h1]
Another thing we’ve addressed was our main art. It wasn’t that we weren't satisfied with the one we had. On the contrary we really liked how straightforward it presented the top down perspective and at the same time shown the danger of Soulblight lurking behind the character. The thing that we considered a problem was the fact that once you scaled it down its readability dropped drastically. This unfortunately was a deal breaker as most of the time the art will be viewed in a crowded social media feed. And so we’ve decided to prepare a new one. This time focusing on the character and it’s transformation into something evil.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/58b62898439544daa6d287715c3a1cc495ab3617.png[/img]

[h1]Social goals[/h1]
To make our campaign more fun we’ve decided to gamify it a little bit and set up some social goals. Have a look at these three “vaults” we have created.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/bae89a8552765403357a969b964ca6190073a4c1.png[/img]

Each of the vaults contains a special piece of in-game equipment. When opened the item will be revealed and added to the final game. How to unlock them? By reaching our social goals. The number on top of the vault shows how many are needed. Here’s the complete list of our social goals:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/f7ae3bbf116e0aa2fc70f1737a54097b2a894e9e.png[/img]

If you want you can already help us reaching the social goals :) Here are all the links:
[list]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/530930/Soulblight/]Steam Page[/url]
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/MyNextGames]Facebook Fan Page[/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/MyNextGames]Twitter page[/url]
[*][url=https://www.reddit.com/r/MyNextGames/]Subreddit[/url]
[*][url=https://www.mynextgames.com/]Newsletter[/url]
[/list]

That would be all for today folks :) I would like to once more thank you for all your support and patience. Especially thank you for all the words of encouragement you sent our way after we were forced to delay our Kickstarter campaign. It meant a lot to us!

Cya Around,
Kuba

P.S If you would like to help us with the announcement of the Kickstarter campaign, and you haven’t done so already, don’t forget to [url=https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/59652-soulblight-live-on-kickstarter]support our Thunderclap![/url]

notes.title: Soulblight Alpha Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308370/10587c3ec03b8b6d53c36bd46e05604e082393d2.png[/img]
One of you (Edwin) suggested that I would post the Alpha Update change logs here to help you all follow on the development. This is an Awesome idea. Not sure why I haven't thought about it earlier :P It happens that I just uploaded new update so here comes the first one:

[list]
[*]The alpha build is now in the form of Kickstarter Demo. It's a bit shorter as we don't want to show the locations that still contain assets in a concept stage(like camp and chapel)
[*]Chrono Inhibitor armor set added. Armor of this type allows you to use time slowing mechanic. 
[*]Spiked armor set added. Armor deals passive damage to the enemy when in Grip.
[*]First light armor set added.
[*]Items made of black steel can no longer kill you. When you equip an item with that tag while on full wounds you simply don't receive the Black Steel Curse buff until you heal.
[*]6 light shields added
[*]6 medium shields added
[*]6 heavy shields added
[*]Spear primary attack speed has been increased. This weapon type seemed to be a bit under-powered.
[*]The loot you receive as a taint reward is now more varied.
[*]Bosses movement speed increased. You should no longer be able to infinity kite him. 
[*]Now when you’re sneaking through the creaking zone the range in which the sound is heard depends on how fast you're walking (You can sneak slower by gently moving the analog stick)
[/list]

P.S
If you'r interested in checking out Soulblight sign up for the alpha demo at www.mynextgames.com
You can also  support our upcoming kickstarter. it goes live on AUG 17th here's the thunderclap link: https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/59652-soulblight-live-on-kickstarter
